pairs.subject: prompt-assembly
pairs.evidence: scripts/agent/dispatch.mjs:391 The prompt describes the dispatcher's refusal boundary in hand-written prose that names only a subset of PROTECTED_PREFIXES (it leaves out package.json, data/, deploy/helm/, the *-budget.json ceilings and most of scripts/), and it never states the MAX_FILES/MAX_FILE_BYTES/MAX_TOTAL_BYTES caps, so guardPlan can refuse a plan the prompt allowed only after both paid rounds have run.

techniques.evidence: scripts/agent/dispatch.mjs:391 Hand-written subset of the guard's authority, which is PROTECTED_PREFIXES at line 162; the prompt is not rendered from it, and the file caps enforced at lines 311-346 are never taught.

scripts/agent/dispatch.mjs:635 No reservation is passed, so the lane inherits the reviewer's fixed max_tokens 4096 (scripts/review/agent-review.mjs:178). Round 2 asks for WHOLE file contents up to MAX_TOTAL_BYTES 240_000 (about 60k tokens). Nobody chose this ceiling for this lane.

scripts/agent/dispatch.mjs:493 The issue text is fenced and labelled untrusted, but the round-1 model output (prior model output derived from that same untrusted issue) is interpolated into round 2 bare: no fence and no trust label.

scripts/agent/dispatch.mjs:137 Agent-prompt digests only SYSTEM_PROMPT. The constitution rubric (buildRubric, sent first in both rounds) is a standing layer that is left out of the digest, so a rubric edit changes what the model was told without changing the stamp. The harness digest of the dispatch.mjs source (line 120) is conformant.
scripts/agent/dispatch.mjs:431 Each round has one assembler that takes typed inputs. The system/policy layer is separate (SYSTEM_PROMPT), and the rubric leads each round.

scripts/agent/dispatch.mjs:269 Per-file caps name what they dropped in the prompt, and the inventory heading carries total and 'truncated' (line 446). The section caps are reasoned against the lane total in agent-budget.json.
scripts/agent/dispatch.mjs:244 Round 1 inlines paths only. The contents the model can request are pulled on demand instead of being inlined.
scripts/agent/dispatch.mjs:379 Opens with a permission/autonomy fact rather than an expertise claim. A decline path and an output contract are stated.
scripts/agent/dispatch.mjs:404 Two stateless single-message calls. No accumulated transcript, so the compaction family (and elision/folding) has no precondition here.
